description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketWithItemsSpecification class, verifying its behavior in filtering baskets by basket ID and buyer ID, using mocked Basket objects.

classes.name: BasketWithItems
classes.description: Unit test class for BasketWithItemsSpecification, containing tests that verify the specification's correct behavior when selecting baskets based on id and buyer id.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBasketId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with a given basket ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBasketIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that the specification does not match any baskets when given a non-existent basket ID.

methods.name: MatchesBasketWithGivenBuyerId
methods.description: Tests that the specification correctly matches a basket with a specified buyer ID.

methods.name: MatchesNoBasketsIfBuyerIdNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that no baskets are matched when an incorrect buyer ID is used.

methods.name: GetTestBasketCollection
methods.description: Creates a list of mocked Basket objects for testing purposes, with preset IDs and buyer ID.
